title: Desilting / Clearing of Canal (Manual) - MAIN CANAL END OF CANAL (23+628)
performedByIA: SAMAHANG MAGPAPATUBIG NG BAYANAN 2 IRRIGATORS' ASSOCIATION, INC.
performedByDetails: by Mindoro Oriental-Marinduque-Romblon IMO; by IA: SAMAHANG MAGPAPATUBIG NG BAYANAN 2 IRRIGATORS' ASSOCIATION, INC.
remarks: Manual canal desilting and vegetation clearing operations along Main Canal End Of Canal (Sta. 23+628) were undertaken by NIA Personnel in close coordination with SAMAHANG MAGPAPATUBIG NG BAYANAN 2 IRRIGATORS' ASSOCIATION, INC.. Prior to intervention, initial site inspection revealed vegetation overgrowth and fine sand (banlik) deposit, which significantly restricted design water conveyance. During operations, maintenance personnel carried out excavator removing vegetation from canal and scooping and desilting canal bed, using rented equipment. With all target works completed and verified on-site, the canal section has been restored to optimal operating condition.
